cells.docstring: Opens a connection to the SQLite database file on disk.

database_path.description: Filesystem path to the SQLite database file.

cells.docstring: Opens an isolated, high-performance in-memory SQLite database connection.
Opens a database connection using URI filename handling for flags like mode=ro or cache=shared.

connection.description: Database connection handle opened in URI mode.

cells.docstring: Configures row_factory on the connection to sqlite3.Row for column-name keyed indexing.
Configures transaction isolation level or enables autocommit mode when set to None.

out_connection.description: Connection configured with specified isolation level.

cells.docstring: Configures the busy handler lock timeout in seconds on the active connection.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout duration in seconds to wait for database locks.

cells.docstring: Creates a new Cursor handle from an open database connection.
Closes the database cursor handle and releases underlying resources.

status.description: True when cursor is successfully closed.

cells.docstring: Executes a CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statement to initialize relational schema.

schema_ddl.description: Column definitions (e.g. 'id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL').
schema_ddl.default_value: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT

cells.code_template:
{cursor}.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS " + str({table_name}) + " (" + str({schema_ddl}) + ")")
{out_cursor} = {cursor}

cells.docstring: Executes a DROP TABLE IF EXISTS statement to remove a relational table.
Creates an index on specified table columns to accelerate query lookups.

columns.description: Comma-separated column names to index (e.g. 'user_id, created_at').

cells.code_template:
{cursor}.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS " + str({index_name}) + " ON " + str({table_name}) + " (" + str({columns}) + ")")
{out_cursor} = {cursor}

cells.docstring: Applies schema migration by adding a new column to an existing table.
Queries sqlite_master to introspect all user table names in the database.
cells.code_template:
{cursor}.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'")
{table_names} = [row[0] for row in {cursor}.fetchall()]

cells.docstring: Executes PRAGMA table_info to inspect column metadata for a target table.

schema_info.description: List of tuples with column metadata.

cells.docstring: Executes a raw non-parameterized SQL statement string.
Executes a parameterized SQL query safely binding placeholder values against a cursor.

sql.description: SQL statement string containing ? parameter placeholders.

parameters.description: Tuple of parameter values to bind safely.

cells.docstring: Executes a parameterized SQL query repeatedly across an iterable of parameter sequences.

seq_of_parameters.description: Sequence of parameter tuples for batch binding.

cells.docstring: Executes a multi-statement SQL script separated by semicolons.
Constructs and executes a parameterized INSERT INTO statement for a single record.
Executes a parameterized UPDATE statement against records matching a WHERE predicate.

parameters.description: Tuple of parameters matching SET and WHERE placeholders.

cells.docstring: Executes a parameterized DELETE FROM statement matching a WHERE predicate.

parameters.description: Tuple of parameters bound to WHERE clause.

cells.docstring: Retrieves the single next row record from an executed cursor query.

row.description: Single row record tuple or None if no rows remaining.

cells.docstring: Retrieves all remaining row records from an executed cursor query as a list.
Retrieves the next batch of up to size rows from an executed cursor.

size.description: Maximum number of rows to retrieve.

cells.docstring: Extracts the number of rows modified by the most recent execute statement.
Extracts the rowid or auto-increment primary key ID generated by the last INSERT.

last_id.description: Generated integer rowid of the inserted record.

cells.docstring: Maps an iterable of sqlite3.Row objects to standard Python dictionaries keyed by column name.

dict_records.description: List of dictionaries mapping column names to values.

cells.docstring: Commits the current transaction, making all pending database writes durable.
Rolls back all uncommitted changes from the start of the current transaction.
Category-Theoretic Transaction Context: auto-commits on clean exit and auto-rollbacks on exception.
Executes a PRAGMA directive to configure database engine parameters like WAL journal mode or foreign keys.
Queries the current value of a PRAGMA parameter on the connection.
Registers a custom Python scalar function (UDF) callable directly within SQL statements.

function_name.description: Name of the SQL function to register.

num_params.description: Number of function arguments (-1 for variadic).

cells.docstring: Registers a custom user-defined aggregate function class having step and finalize methods.

aggregate_name.description: Name of the aggregate function in SQL.

num_params.description: Number of arguments the step method accepts.

aggregate_class.description: Class implementing step and finalize methods.

cells.docstring: Registers a custom string comparison collation callable on the database connection.

callable_func.description: Comparison function taking two strings and returning negative, zero, or positive integer.

cells.docstring: Registers a trace callback invoked with statement text for every executed query.

trace_callback.description: Callback receiving SQL string or None to disable tracing.

cells.docstring: Registers a progress handler callback invoked periodically during long-running SQLite operations.

handler.description: Handler returning non-zero to abort execution or None to clear.

n_instructions.description: Number of SQLite VM instructions between handler invocations.

cells.docstring: Registers an authorizer callback invoked during query compilation to inspect and filter permissions.

authorizer_callback.description: Authorizer callback returning SQLITE_OK, SQLITE_DENY, or SQLITE_IGNORE.

cells.docstring: Enables or disables dynamic extension loading on the database connection handle.

enabled.description: True to enable loading SQLite extensions, False to disable.

out_connection.description: Connection with updated extension loading permissions.

cells.docstring: Loads a compiled shared library SQLite extension module into the database connection.

connection.description: Database connection handle with extension loading enabled.

extension_path.description: Filesystem path to the extension shared library.

cells.docstring: Retrieves the total count of database row mutations since the connection was opened.
Checks whether the connection is currently inside an active transaction.

is_in_tx.description: True if a transaction is currently open, False otherwise.

cells.docstring: Iterates through database SQL definitions and rows, producing a complete text dump script.

dump_sql.description: Full SQL text script reconstructing the database.

cells.docstring: Aborts any pending or long-running database operation on the connection.
Streams data from source database connection into destination database connection using SQLite Online Backup API.

status.description: True when online backup completes successfully.

cells.docstring: Streams in-memory or active database contents to a permanent SQLite database file on disk.

target_db_path.description: Destination filesystem path for database backup.

backup_success.description: True when backup is completely flushed to disk.

cells.docstring: Closes the SQLite database connection handle, releasing file locks.
